name: upbeat-web
description: UpBeat — Minimalist AI Music Curator & Player

scripts.build:win: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm --prefix electron install && npm --prefix electron run dist:win
scripts.test:backend: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s backend/tests -v; else python3 -m unittest discover -s backend/tests -v; fi
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:ui && npm run test:backend
